### Arithmetic and final result

The eight posted HA-AUG-M1..M8 meter slices are 230+240+260+250+280+260+220+260 = 2000 instance-hours. HA-AUG-CANCELLED (99) is cancelled and excluded. No posted primary reversal or prior source correction exists. Period source net threshold basis is 12000, below 25000. Negotiated approval absent, commitment none, promotion expired, dedicated rather than spot: ordinary reduction zero. Tier rate .752, US West factor 1.04, dedicated multiplier 1.16; same-entity Support $50k discount .035. Review = round_half_up(2000 × .752 × 1.04 × 1.16 × 1 × .965, 2) = 1750.92. Settlement target = round_half_up(1750.92 × .965, 2) = 1689.64. Credit = -(12000 + 0 - 1689.64) = -10310.36, with net equal amount and tax zero.

Complete-history receivable begins zero: current charge 12000 and payment -12000 cancel; May 1540/-1540, June 1620/-1620 and July 1580/-1580 also cancel. After credit, receivable is -10310.36. Payment remaining principal is 12000, with no prior return/refund. Support minimum fee/payout cap is 3450. Permitted assessment = min(10310.36,12000,3450) = 3450.00, above inclusive Compute minimum 1.00. Current authority remains min(3450,3450)=3450.00. One customer refund leaves receivable -6860.36; retained surplus 6860.36. No further payout follows.

Root → eligible positive assessment (doc 52: “Before the customer executes an assisted immediate refund, the exact original payment and filed request must have an approved eligible refund assessment with a positive assessed refund amount.”). find_compute_events in returns_2 contains neither a correction nor an eligible assessment for these exact objects; both gates are unmet.

The returned evidence packet is service_record/completed/decision none, not compute_review/approved/incorrect, so the review gate is also unmet. The service export and packet exist, allowing the review now. Each bearing operation document independently identifies its own tool and receipt linkage.

Execution order (all unlocked): agent review_compute_line_e30849b6(net_amount=1750.92, packet/source/export), then agent credit_compute_line_adb33dcc(amount=-10310.36, newly returned review as both evidence and related reference), then agent authorize_compute_refund_4fb241f0(credited_amount=3450.00, existing request/payment/charge, new credit reference), then agent unlock/handoff and user refund_compute_payment_f0565a85(amount=3450.00, original request/payment, approved assessment receipt). Receipts are review_compute_line72670c540055, credit_compute_linec5676623a2dc, authorize_compute_refund1d13f0344599, refund_compute_payment7bca49060554, copied from actual prior returns. Requests/returns batches 4–7 demonstrate each executable edge. Last call is user-owned and no subsequent call consumes its receipt. Terminal: one refund posted, source corrected, authorized residual retained, existing pending consent remains the customer-filed request.

### Counter-proofs

“Do only the refund” fails both root prerequisite sentences above; a completed physical packet is insufficient under credit's explicit approved incorrect arithmetic-review condition. Another holding/invoice/month/export is excluded by exact-source and selected-holding clauses. Cancelled 99 is excluded explicitly. Today's support channel cannot replace the original charge channel. Adding two support rates is excluded by “second successive reduction, never a rate added to the earlier pricing adjustment.” Reviewing 2000 × 6 uses the erroneous invoice unit price rather than the published contracted rate. The currently recomputed ceiling and assessment minimum exclude payout of full 10310.36 surplus or 12000 principal. Agent-executed customer disposal is explicitly prohibited; a new signature approval wait is excluded by pending/none request scope and synchronous workflow. The distinct workflow document contains an explicit ordered route; its source legitimacy remains a post-freeze scan question.

#### Visible document 45: Virtual Compute: assisted cash resolution procedure

## Situation

Virtual Compute — An existing customer-filed maximum-refund request concerns the latest paid primary source line. A corrected source target creates a surplus whose permitted payout is assessed by the accountant and disposed of by the customer personally; one payout completes the request, with any remaining surplus retained.

## Ordered action 1

1. The agent records the primary arithmetic review using review_compute_line_e30849b6. Every physical export and original source charge already exists; the desk completes this arithmetic review synchronously.

## Ordered action 2

2. The agent posts the primary correction credit using credit_compute_line_adb33dcc. The preceding review provides the approved incorrect target; this call immediately posts the correction.

## Ordered action 3

3. The agent records the numerical refund assessment using authorize_compute_refund_4fb241f0. The original filed request and posted payment preexist the consultation; the preceding credit is now posted. The accountant performs the request/payment reconciliation and records its numerical assessment synchronously.

## Ordered action 4

4. The customer themselves executes the permitted refund using refund_compute_payment_f0565a85. Original customer consent is recorded at opening; the preceding accountant tool has completed the eligibility assessment and returns its reference. The customer immediately executes the handed-over disposition tool; no later action depends on its receipt.

## Reference handovers

The review reference becomes the correction’s related evidence. The correction reference becomes the assessment’s posted-correction reference. The approved assessment reference becomes the customer refund’s related evidence.

## Ordering basis

The primary review precedes correction because its approved net target determines the credit. The credit precedes the refund assessment because the exact posted correction reference and its resulting surplus are inputs to that assessment. The assessment precedes customer disposition because its approved numerical ceiling and returned reference constrain the actual payout. Customer signature consent is already present on the original request; no asynchronous signature approval, payment clearing or other external event is manufactured.

## Synchronous execution

All original customer consent, export and posted payment records preexist the consultation. Review, credit and refund assessment are synchronous accountant actions. The customer then executes the final disposition using the already returned assessment reference; no subsequent call consumes the user-generated receipt.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, correction before review lacks the approved target; assessment before correction lacks the posted credit reference and its resulting surplus; customer payout before assessment lacks the approved ceiling and returned assessment reference.

The selected payment has exactly one pending customer refund request in this package; the existing request names that original payment and its paid primary charge. An existing approved eligible assessment for that payment is read-only, including when the same request is repeated; this package creates no second eligible assessment for the payment.
